change_note: First version: what each company on the stock lists does, in two short lines, for Swipe mode and the simple cards.
how_to_read: What each company does, in plain words. Written by hand from public knowledge; no prices, ratings or forecasts.

companies.AAPL: Makes the iPhone, Mac, iPad and Apple Watch. Also earns a growing share from services like the App Store, iCloud and Apple Pay.
companies.ADBE: Adobe makes Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere and Acrobat (PDF). Creative people pay a monthly subscription.
companies.AEP: A big US power company that brings electricity to about 5.5 million customers in 11 states. Prices are set with state regulators.
companies.AMD: Designs computer, server and gaming chips, and AI chips that compete with Nvidia. Intel is its old rival.
companies.AMGN: One of the biggest biotech companies. Makes medicines for bone loss, cholesterol, cancer and inflammation, and is testing a weight-loss drug.
companies.AMZN: The largest online store in the US, and owner of AWS, the biggest cloud service. Also Prime Video, ads and Alexa.
companies.ANET: Arista Networks makes fast network switches that connect the servers inside big cloud and AI data centers.
companies.ARM: Arm designs the chip blueprints used in almost every phone and more and more in data centers. It earns a fee on each chip made.
companies.ASML: A Dutch company that makes the giant machines chipmakers use to print circuits on silicon. The only maker of the EUV machines needed for the most advanced chips.
companies.ASTS: AST SpaceMobile is building satellites that connect directly to ordinary phones, with AT&T, Verizon and Vodafone as partners.
companies.AVGO: Makes chips for networks, phones and data centers, including custom AI chips for Google and others. Also sells business software (VMware).
companies.BKSY: BlackSky takes fast satellite pictures and analyzes them with AI, mostly for governments and armies.
companies.CAMT: An Israeli company that makes machines inspecting chips for defects, especially the advanced chips used for AI.
companies.CHKP: An Israeli cybersecurity company that makes firewalls and security software protecting company networks.
companies.CME: Runs the world's largest futures exchange, where traders bet on interest rates, stocks, oil and grain. Earns a small fee on every trade.
companies.COP: One of the largest US companies that only finds and pumps oil and gas, without refineries or gas stations.
companies.COST: Runs Costco warehouse stores where members pay a yearly fee to buy in bulk at low prices. Membership fees bring most of its profit.
companies.CRM: Salesforce makes the most used software for sales and customer service teams, now adding AI assistants.
companies.CRWD: CrowdStrike makes cybersecurity software that protects company computers and servers from hackers.
companies.CRWV: CoreWeave rents out AI computing power (Nvidia chips) in its own data centers. Listed in 2025 and carries a lot of debt.
companies.CTAS: Rents and cleans work uniforms for businesses, and supplies first-aid and safety products. Customers pay every week, so income is steady.
companies.CVX: Chevron, one of the biggest oil and gas companies in the world. Its results follow oil prices.
companies.DDOG: Datadog makes software that watches companies' apps and servers and warns them when something breaks.
companies.DELL: Dell makes PCs, laptops and servers. AI servers for big companies are now its fastest-growing business.
companies.DXYZ: A fund that owns shares in about 100 private tech companies (like SpaceX before it listed), so the public can invest in them.
companies.EOG: A big US shale oil and gas producer, known for keeping costs low.
companies.ESLT: Israel's largest defense company. Makes drones, radars, night-vision and weapons systems for Israel and other armies.
companies.FANG: An oil and gas producer in the Permian Basin in Texas. Its results follow the price of oil.
companies.FLY: Firefly Aerospace builds small rockets and Moon landers. Its Blue Ghost lander touched down on the Moon in 2025.
companies.GILD: A drug maker best known for HIV medicines, which bring most of its sales. Also sells cancer and liver-disease treatments.
companies.GLBE: An Israeli company that helps online stores sell to buyers in other countries: prices, taxes, payment and shipping.
companies.GOOGL: Owns Google Search, YouTube, Android and Google Cloud. Most of its money comes from ads shown in search and videos.
companies.GSAT: Globalstar runs the satellites behind emergency text messages on iPhones. Apple is its biggest partner.
companies.GTLB: GitLab makes a platform where software teams store, test and ship their code. Microsoft's GitHub is its big rival.
companies.ICL: An Israeli company that mines potash and phosphate from the Dead Sea and elsewhere, for fertilizers and industry.
companies.IEZ: A fund holding US oil-equipment and services companies, the ones that drill and service the wells.
companies.INTU: Intuit makes TurboTax, QuickBooks and Credit Karma, money software for people and small businesses.
companies.IRDM: Iridium runs a network of satellites that gives phone and data service anywhere on Earth, for ships, planes and soldiers.
companies.ISRG: Makes the da Vinci surgical robot that surgeons use for less invasive operations. Hospitals keep buying its tools and parts for every surgery.
companies.KRMN: Karman makes hard-to-build parts for missiles, rockets and satellites, mainly for defense companies.
companies.LIN: The world's largest maker of industrial gases like oxygen, nitrogen and hydrogen. Factories and hospitals sign long contracts with it.
companies.LUNR: Intuitive Machines builds Moon landers and works for NASA. In 2024 it made the first private landing on the Moon.
companies.MDB: MongoDB makes a popular database that app developers use to store their data, in the cloud or on their own servers.
companies.META: Owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, used by billions of people. Earns almost all its money from ads, and spends big on AI.
companies.MNDY: An Israeli company that makes monday.com, online software teams use to plan and track their work.
companies.MNST: Makes Monster energy drinks, sold in over 140 countries. Coca-Cola owns part of it and distributes its drinks.
companies.MSFT: Makes Windows, Office and Teams, and runs Azure, one of the two biggest cloud services. A main partner of OpenAI.
companies.MU: Makes memory chips (DRAM and flash) for phones, computers and AI servers. Prices swing a lot with supply and demand.
companies.NET: Cloudflare runs a global network that makes websites faster and protects them from attacks.
companies.NICE: An Israeli software company for customer-service centers: it records and analyzes calls and chats, more and more with AI.
companies.NOW: ServiceNow makes software big companies use to run IT, HR and customer requests in one place.
companies.NVDA: Designs the chips that train and run most AI. Data centers buy its GPUs by the thousands; gaming chips are its older business.
companies.NVMI: An Israeli company that makes machines measuring chips during manufacturing, so chip factories catch mistakes early.
companies.ORA: Builds and runs geothermal power plants that make electricity from the earth's heat, in the US and abroad. Started in Israel.
companies.ORCL: Makes database software big companies run on, and a fast-growing cloud that rents out AI computing.
companies.PANW: Palo Alto Networks is one of the largest cybersecurity companies: firewalls, cloud security and security operations.
companies.PCAR: Makes Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF heavy trucks. Also earns from truck parts and from loans to buyers.
companies.PEP: Makes Pepsi, Gatorade and Lay's, Doritos and other snacks. Snacks bring more money than drinks.
companies.PL: Planet Labs runs hundreds of small satellites that photograph the whole Earth every day, and sells the pictures and data.
companies.PLTR: Palantir makes software that helps governments, armies and big companies make sense of their data, now with AI.
companies.QCOM: Designs the chips inside most Android phones and earns fees on phone patents. Now also selling chips for cars and laptops.
companies.RDW: Redwire makes parts for spacecraft: solar arrays, cameras and systems for building things in space.
companies.RIG: Transocean owns and rents out drilling rigs for deep water, far offshore. Oil companies pay a daily rate per rig.
companies.RKLB: Rocket Lab launches small satellites with its Electron rocket and builds satellite parts. Its bigger Neutron rocket is next.
companies.SHOP: Shopify's software lets businesses open and run an online store. It powers millions of shops worldwide.
companies.SLB: The world's largest oilfield services company. Oil companies hire it to find, drill and run their wells.
companies.SMCI: Super Micro builds servers, including AI servers packed with Nvidia chips, for data centers.
companies.SNOW: Snowflake runs a cloud service where companies store and analyze all their data in one place.
companies.SPCX: SpaceX launches most of the world's rockets and satellites, and runs Starlink, internet from space. Listed in June 2026.
companies.SPIR: Spire Global runs small satellites that collect weather, ship and airplane tracking data and sells it.
companies.TEVA: An Israeli drug maker, one of the world's largest makers of generic (copy) medicines. Also sells its own brand drugs.
companies.TMUS: The second-largest US mobile phone carrier. Grew fast with its 5G network and by buying Sprint.
companies.TQQQ: A fund that moves three times as much as the Nasdaq-100 each day, up or down. Very risky to hold for long.
companies.TSEM: An Israeli chip factory (foundry) that makes chips designed by other companies, mostly for cars, phones and data-center networks.
companies.TSLR: A fund that moves twice as much as Tesla stock each day, up or down. Built for short-term trading, risky to hold.
companies.TSM: Taiwan's TSMC makes the most advanced chips in the world for Apple, Nvidia, AMD and others. It designs none of its own.
companies.TSYY: A fund built around Tesla that aims to pay high monthly income using options. Its price can fall a lot when Tesla falls.
companies.VOYG: Voyager Technologies builds defense and space systems and is planning a private space station (Starlab).
companies.VRT: Vertiv makes power and cooling equipment for data centers. AI chips run hot, so demand for cooling grew fast.
companies.VSAT: Viasat sells satellite internet for airplanes, ships and the military. Faces strong competition from Starlink.
companies.WIX: An Israeli company whose tools let anyone build a website without coding. Users pay a monthly subscription.
companies.XEL: A power company in 8 US states, from Minnesota to Texas. A leader in wind energy among US utilities.
companies.XOM: ExxonMobil, the largest US oil and gas company. Pumps oil, refines it and makes chemicals.
companies.XOP: A fund holding many US companies that find and pump oil and gas. It rises and falls with oil prices.
companies.XYZ: Block (formerly Square) runs Square payment tools for small shops and Cash App for sending money. Also owns Afterpay.
